Definition: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of a column, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum
BiblicalUsage: 1) bulb, knob, capital, capital of a pillar; 1a) knob, bulb (as ornament); 1b) capital (of a pillar)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
